whenToUse: Labeled text, email and search fields, plain or restyled as a pill, an underline or borderless
Native typed fields for passwords, phones, URLs, numbers, dates, times, files, colors and ranges
Field states and hints: disabled, required or optional marks, errors, character counts and password strength

whenNotToUse.when: Icons, buttons, units or a prefix that sit inside the border of the box
International numbers chosen by country flag and formatted as the user types
A whole create or edit page that gathers many fields under one save action

agentNotes: The red invalid border comes from `aria-invalid` on `Input` in every style; `FieldError` only prints the message
